audit.why: Ranged-ish laner who farms with Parrrley (Q, 4.5s) and scales on Powder Keg chains. Aatrox wins any fight he can start; Gangplank wins the ones he can barrel away from.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage (R) is 160/140/120 and global — it changes ganks and map play, not the 1v1. World Ender at 120/100/80 is the more frequent spike, so level 6 is still yours.
audit.corrected: Cannon Barrage (R) is global on 160s and decides ganks, not the 1v1. Level 6 is still yours: World Ender out-drains his Parrrley chip once Remove Scurvy (W) is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy (W, 22/20/18/16/14) cures crowd control and heals: it cleanses your Q3 knock-up and your Infernal Chains, so it must be spent before you commit. Powder Keg (E) chains spread the slow and are what kite you out.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Gangplank. Infernal Chains (W) drags him back to the centre if he doesn't leave the zone — but Remove Scurvy (W, 22s at rank 1) cures crowd control, so it cleanses your chain and your Q3 knock-up. Bait it first, then commit. Vs his poke save E to close, not for chip, and break his Powder Kegs before the chain slows you out of range.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Gangplank's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage (R) is global on 160s and decides ganks, not the 1v1. Level 6 is still yours: World Ender out-drains his Parrrley chip once Remove Scurvy (W) is spent.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Gangplank. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. Vs a ranged laner, save E to close the gap or dodge poke — not for chip damage; you only win once you're on top of him. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive Cannon Barrage — never burn it for a single Q.
